feature: Control heartbeat semantics and preservation of pending traffic
checks: Heartbeat before initial map cannot authorize
Heartbeat ignores node, peer, policy and relay fields including incompatible field types
Malformed JSON and duplicate or mistyped KeepAlive revoke authorization
Queued initiation, outbound ciphertext, inbound plaintext and retained delivery survive heartbeat
Non-heartbeat map invalidates retained delivery and policy revocation rejects traffic
limitations: No new independent Headscale/Tailscale run for this change
No physical hardware verification or grayscale rebuild
Optional PingRequest, ControlTime and PopBrowserURL handling not added
Persistent WireGuard keepalive is an optional extension, not a setting in the pinned coordinator peer contract
